task_completion.description: Navigate to the Contacts module in the CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Contacts module header or a list of contact records on the screen.

task_completion.description: Open the interface to create a new custom filter or list view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Create New View' or 'New Filter' configuration screen is visible.

task_completion.description: Set the View Name to 'New York Contacts'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'New York Contacts' is typed into the 'View Name' or 'Filter Name' input field.

task_completion.description: Select the required columns: First Name, Last Name, Primary Email, Mobile Phone, and Mailing City.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see these five specific fields selected in the 'Choose Columns' or 'Select Columns' section of the view configuration.

task_completion.description: Apply a filter where 'Mailing City' equals 'New York'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the filter/conditions section, 'Mailing City' is selected as the field, 'equals' (or 'e') as the operator, and 'New York' is entered as the value.

task_completion.description: Save the view and confirm it is active with the correct name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final screen shows the 'New York Contacts' view selected in the dropdown, and the table headers match the requested columns.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM web interface rather than executing database commands via a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser/CRM GUI, not a command-line interface.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus to reach the view creation screen.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking on module menus and 'Create' buttons rather than just jumping to a final URL.

integrity.description: The agent manually selected the columns and typed the filter values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the selection process for the five columns and the manual entry of the filter criteria.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is performed in vTiger CRM. The view name must be exactly 'New York Contacts'. The required columns are: firstname, lastname, email, mobile, and mailingcity. The filter condition must use the field 'Mailing City' with the 'equals' operator (often represented as 'e' in vTiger's advanced filters) and the value 'New York'.
